text.title: Growth Loops Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable growth-loop signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does existing user behaviour produce a measurable output (invitation, content, referral, listing) that can become a new input, with an event already tracked for it?

conclusion.verdict: no loop fuel to model; instrument the candidate output event first or use a funnel methodology

branch.question: Does the spec show the output of one cycle becoming the input of the next, in the same unit, through that event?

conclusion.verdict: name the reinvestment event or relabel the design as a funnel

branch.question: Which loop-design signal fails on inspection of the spec's metrics table, projection and friction map?

conclusion.verdict: declare one primary loop type and its input source
instrument the stage or flag it as an assumption

branch.when: k_stated == false OR cycle_time_stated == false OR (k < 1 AND described_as_self_sustaining == true)

conclusion.verdict: state k and cycle time; below 1 present the 1/(1-k) multiplier

branch.when: projection_days < 90 OR projection_cycles < 3 OR decay_term == false

conclusion.verdict: rebuild the projection cohort by cohort with decay over 90+ days
name the lowest-conversion stage and rank experiments on it
show payback with and without loop-sourced users, attributed by the fuel-back event
add a numeric activation, retention or index-rate guardrail on loop output
emit the spec artefact; surface ready_for_review=true

text.example: fuel_event_exists=true -> loop_closes=true -> primary_loop_types=1, stage_rates_unflagged_estimates=0, k=0.7, cycle_time_stated=true, projection_days=120, projection_cycles=4, decay_term=true, bottleneck_named=true, cac_payback_with_and_without_loop=true, quality_guardrail_threshold=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
